scope: Post-seal source-only case attribution. Seed readout retired; simplified v1 remains deployed. No fitting, threshold selection, new output rule or FINAL.
cohorts: All rows of the pinned 192 with strict oriented IoU>0.50 available but frozen K16 misses; all frozen hits lost by guarded native Focal. Preserve original anonymous row IDs. Row selection is exhaustive and cohorts are disjoint.
pairs: For a frozen miss use highest frozen score among failed candidates versus highest frozen score among hits. For a seed harm use highest native Focal among failures versus highest Focal among hits, with registered frozen tiebreak; additionally keep actual previous frozen winner and highest-IoU K16 box. Record both scoring functions on identical boxes; report all-K16 counterfactual winners separately. Enumerate the actual original four v1 slots independently.
scores: Audit frozen prior, joint subject unary, direct reference marginal, replayed independent and mismatched reference. Further split prior under original A256 scoring into own subject probability, duplicate density, incoming neighbor votes and any clipping. Decompose focal into unique good/bad seed contributions and negative cost saved / positive cost incurred. No combination of frozen and seed scores. Positive gap always means failed candidate leads.
identity: Review original description, calibrated RGB, 3D target and other available source annotations, actual point returns, BEV and side views. Use same target with geometric error, different physical object, or unresolved (including mixed, unlabelled, background or occluded where identity cannot be resolved). Source boxes and point membership alone do not assign physical instance identity. Do not force identity or claim independent human adjudication. Keep all records.
geometry: On same-instance cases, attribute the IoU difference between the actual failing candidate and best-scored passing candidate to XY center, vertical center, size and yaw by all 16 hybrid boxes (average marginal over orderings). GT used only in post hoc scoring.
delivery: All cases and matched gaps in a sanitized public table. Original wording, RGB, 3D coordinates, physical data and box/seed indices stay local in the casebook. Verify paths and published hashes.
